newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PROFILE OF INJURED ENGLAND STRIKER ALAN SHEARER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PROFILE OF INJURED ENGLAND STRIKER ALAN SHEARER.

text.p: Factfile on England and Newcastle United striker Alan Shearer who is expected to be out of action for months after tearing ankle ligaments on Saturday:
1988: Signed professional contract with Southampton five days after debut when he became youngest player to score a league hat-trick.
1988-89: Failed to score in eight full league appearances for Southampton.z
1989-90: Scored three goals in 26 league matches.
1990-91: Netted four times in 36 league games but earned England under-21 call-up, going on to score a record 13 goals in 11 appearances at that level.
1991-92: Made senior England debut at Wembley, scoring in 2-0 win over France. Travelled with squad to European championship in Sweden, playing in 0-0 draw against France.
July 1992: Moved to Blackburn in a then British record 3.3-million-pound ($5.1-million) deal. He had scored 23 league goals in 118 appearances for Southampton.
1992-93: Scored twice on Blackburn debut in 3-3 draw with Crystal Palace and went on to net 22 times in total that season before suffering serious knee injury. Missed rest of the season.
1993-94: Voted Footballer of the Year after scoring 34 goals.
1994-95: His 34 premier league goals led Blackburn to first title for 81 years. Voted Player of the Year by colleagues.

1995-96: Became first player to reach 100 goals in the premier league, taking only three seasons to do so. Won Golden Boot as top goalscorer at Euro 96 after scoring five times. Moved to Newcastle in world record 15 million pounds ($23.2 million) deal.
1996-97: Missed two chunks of the season after undergoing two operations on his groin but returned to help Newcastle to runners-up spot and a place in the Champions' Cup.
1997-98: Damaged ankle ligaments stretching for a pass in last minute of friendly against Chelsea. Underwent operation and will be out for at least two months.
